documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: Our managed services team struggles with inconsistent reporting. We want workflow coordination and account reporting. Please arrange a discovery meeting to understand our requirements. No budget has been approved.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer's managed services team is struggling with 'inconsistent reporting' and seeks 'workflow coordination and account reporting' to address this. They have requested a discovery meeting to clarify their requirements, but no budget has been approved yet. The account is currently in the 'qualified' stage with verified consent and ownership.

claims.quote: Our managed services team struggles with inconsistent reporting.
We want workflow coordination and account reporting.
Please arrange a discovery meeting to understand our requirements.

raw_proposal.draft: Thank you for reaching out. I understand that your managed services team is currently struggling with inconsistent reporting, and you're looking for workflow coordination and account reporting to address this. A discovery meeting would be a great next step to clarify your specific requirements. I'll schedule that for you shortly.
questions: What specific systems or tools are currently being used for reporting, and what challenges are you facing with them?
Are there any specific departments or teams that are most impacted by the inconsistent reporting?
Do you have any preferred integration methods or vendor connectors in mind for the workflow coordination?
uncertainties: No budget has been approved, so we should be prepared to discuss cost-effective solutions or phased implementation options.
